value.text: Got the Preschool Sports and Games page for Maya. It runs Wednesdays at 10:30 AM, ages 3 to 5, and she fits. It's $280.60 ($290.60 non-resident), course code 00028147. Residents open Sep 8, and the public opens Tuesday, September 15 at 10:30 a.m. I had Monday the 14th before, but the page says the 15th, so I'm going by the page. There's a registration form to fill out first, so leave a little time for that before the 15th.
